recovery_actions.title: Isolate Compromised Host(s) from Production Network
recovery_actions.description: Perform network-level quarantine for host(s): WIN-WORKSTATION-01, CORP-DC-01. Maintain only EDR sensor connection to prevent lateral pivot while preserving volatile evidence.
recovery_actions.verification_step: Confirm host ping is dropped and only management EDR traffic is permitted.

recovery_actions.title: Enforce Perimeter Firewall Blocks for Observed C2 Indicators
recovery_actions.description: Immediately block all outbound and inbound traffic to command-and-control IP(s): 198.51.100.22 across enterprise perimeter firewalls, egress proxies, and DNS resolvers.
recovery_actions.verification_step: Verify firewall drop rule counters increment on synthetic test beacon.

recovery_actions.title: Revoke Active Sessions and Reset Credentials for Compromised Accounts
recovery_actions.description: Terminate active Kerberos tickets, refresh tokens, and force password change for identity/account(s): admin.
recovery_actions.verification_step: Query Active Directory / IdP to ensure password last set timestamp is updated and active tokens revoked.

recovery_actions.title: Eradicate Malicious Persistence Mechanisms and Payloads
recovery_actions.description: Delete unauthorized scheduled tasks (e.g., 'update.exe'), purge registry Run keys, and delete malicious payloads matching hashes: 7f83b1657ff1fc53b92dc18148a1d65dfc2d4b1fa3d677284addd200126d9069.
recovery_actions.verification_step: Execute Schtasks query and filesystem hash check to verify binary and task removal.

recovery_actions.title: Scan File System with Custom YARA Rules for Residual Droppers
recovery_actions.description: Run full-disk forensic YARA scan across all affected endpoints to ensure no secondary droppers remain.
recovery_actions.verification_step: Verify YARA scan report returns zero undetected matches across disk volumes.

recovery_actions.title: Rebuild or Restore Endpoints from Verified Clean Golden Images
recovery_actions.description: Re-image impacted endpoints from clean baseline templates or restore data from offline backups prior to confirmed compromise timestamp.
recovery_actions.verification_step: Confirm golden image integrity checksum and ensure latest OS security updates applied.

recovery_actions.title: Gradual Network Re-Integration under Elevated Telemetry Monitoring
recovery_actions.description: Re-attach restored systems to their production subnets with real-time EDR debug-level auditing enabled for 72 hours.
recovery_actions.verification_step: Audit telemetry stream to ensure zero anomalous network beacons or unauthorized process spawns.

recovery_actions.title: Implement Attack Surface Reduction & PowerShell Constrained Language Mode
recovery_actions.description: Enforce PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode via AppLocker/WDAC and disable WScript/CScript execution for standard domain users.
recovery_actions.verification_step: Verify Group Policy Object (GPO) propagation and test PowerShell execution policy restriction.

recovery_actions.title: Update SIEM Correlation Rules for Observed TTPs
recovery_actions.description: Deploy detection rules targeting cmd.exe -> powershell.exe parent-child anomalies and unusual outbound socket connections on non-standard ports.
recovery_actions.verification_step: Trigger detection rule unit test and confirm alert dispatch to SOC queue.

### Section 1: Executive Incident Summary & Severity
Investigation impact assessment establishes an overall ARGUS Investigation Severity Score (ISS) of **5.6/10.0 (MEDIUM)**. ARGUS Investigation Severity Score (ISS) calculated at 5.6/10.0 (MEDIUM). Primary impact drivers: Asset Criticality & Enterprise Exposure (2.38 pts) & System Integrity & Persistence Depth (1.5 pts).

### Section 2: Affected Assets & Threat Blast Radius
A total of 3 system assets and identities were evaluated:
- **WIN-WORKSTATION-01** (ENDPOINT, Criticality: MEDIUM): State: CONFIRMED_COMPROMISED, Assessed Risk: 8.5/10. Target of Command_and_Control execution: 'Finding F-103 details continuous encrypted TLS beaconing from WIN-WORKSTATION-01 to external IP 198.'
- **admin** (USER_ACCOUNT, Criticality: HIGH): State: CONFIRMED_COMPROMISED, Assessed Risk: 9.0/10. Privileged account authority utilized: Finding F-104 shows user 'admin' on WIN-WORKSTATION-01 creating scheduled task u
- **CORP-DC-01** (DOMAIN_CONTROLLER, Criticality: CRITICAL): State: TARGETED, Assessed Risk: 8.0/10. Target host targeted via lateral movement.

### Section 3: Technical Vulnerability Analysis (CVSS v3.1 Assessment)
CVSS v3.1 Base Score: **7.4 (HIGH)**
Vector String: `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:N/I:H/A:N`
Exploitability Subscore: 2.8 | Impact Subscore: 4.0
All 8 CVSS v3.1 base metrics substantiated by forensic investigation evidence.

### Section 4: Investigation Severity Score (ISS) Business Impact Breakdown
Investigation-level severity is derived from 6 weighted forensic dimensions:
- **Asset Criticality & Enterprise Exposure**: Raw=9.5/10, Weighted Contribution=2.38 pts (Critical infrastructure asset(s) compromised (e.g. Domain Controller, Core Database).)
- **Data Compromise & Confidentiality Exposure**: Raw=1.0/10, Weighted Contribution=0.2 pts (No sensitive data access, credential theft, or exfiltration detected.)
- **System Integrity & Persistence Depth**: Raw=7.5/10, Weighted Contribution=1.5 pts (Persistent malware execution mechanism established (scheduled task/registry).)
- **Operational Availability & Service Downtime**: Raw=1.0/10, Weighted Contribution=0.15 pts (Standard system availability preserved; no service interruption observed.)
- **Scope of Compromise & Lateral Movement**: Raw=6.0/10, Weighted Contribution=0.6 pts (Lateral movement confirmed to a secondary system.)
- **Technical Vulnerability Severity (CVSS Baseline)**: Raw=7.4/10, Weighted Contribution=0.74 pts (Directly derived from deterministic CVSS v3.1 base score (7.4/10.0).)

### Section 5: Priority Containment & Recovery Guidance
The incident response team must execute the following prioritized operations immediately:
- **[CONTAINMENT] (P1_IMMEDIATE) REC-001**: Isolate Compromised Host(s) from Production Network (SOC_L2)
  *Task*: Perform network-level quarantine for host(s): WIN-WORKSTATION-01, CORP-DC-01. Maintain only EDR sensor connection to prevent lateral pivot while preserving volatile evidence.
  *Verification*: Confirm host ping is dropped and only management EDR traffic is permitted.
- **[CONTAINMENT] (P1_IMMEDIATE) REC-002**: Enforce Perimeter Firewall Blocks for Observed C2 Indicators (NETWORK_ADMIN)
  *Task*: Immediately block all outbound and inbound traffic to command-and-control IP(s): 198.51.100.22 across enterprise perimeter firewalls, egress proxies, and DNS resolvers.
  *Verification*: Verify firewall drop rule counters increment on synthetic test beacon.
- **[CONTAINMENT] (P1_IMMEDIATE) REC-003**: Revoke Active Sessions and Reset Credentials for Compromised Accounts (IAM_ADMIN)
  *Task*: Terminate active Kerberos tickets, refresh tokens, and force password change for identity/account(s): admin.
  *Verification*: Query Active Directory / IdP to ensure password last set timestamp is updated and active tokens revoked.
- **[ERADICATION] (P2_HIGH) REC-004**: Eradicate Malicious Persistence Mechanisms and Payloads (SYSADMIN)
  *Task*: Delete unauthorized scheduled tasks (e.g., 'update.exe'), purge registry Run keys, and delete malicious payloads matching hashes: 7f83b1657ff1fc53b92dc18148a1d65dfc2d4b1fa3d677284addd200126d9069.
  *Verification*: Execute Schtasks query and filesystem hash check to verify binary and task removal.
- **[ERADICATION] (P2_HIGH) REC-005**: Scan File System with Custom YARA Rules for Residual Droppers (FORENSIC_ANALYST)
  *Task*: Run full-disk forensic YARA scan across all affected endpoints to ensure no secondary droppers remain.
  *Verification*: Verify YARA scan report returns zero undetected matches across disk volumes.
